description: This file defines the `OFBizRealm` class, a custom implementation extending `RealmBase` for authentication and authorization within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with the entity system to retrieve user credentials and constructs Principal objects for security purposes.

classes.name: OFBizRealm
classes.description: A custom Tomcat realm that authenticates users by querying the OFBiz entity system to retrieve user credentials and assigns roles.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the current password for a given username from the OFBiz 'UserLogin' entity.

methods.name: getPrincipal
methods.description: Creates a Principal object for a given username, with roles currently empty.
